Variant of: Militech M-76E Omaha
Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)
Class: Heavy Pistol
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Long Barrel, Tech Rebuild, Zenith (effects already included in these stats)

Darkhound variant: a Barghest-modified version of the listed original. It ablates 1 extra SP whenever it would ablate armor. Ammo bought for it costs double, is one Price Category higher, and only fits the weapon it was bought for. Unless stated here, it keeps the original's rules.

Once charged, the Tech Rebuild stays charged until the end of a Turn in which it fires; while charged it stays ROF 2 and every attack fires a 3-round burst. Extra ablation totals +1 SP uncharged and +2 SP charged, Darkhound bonus included. +1 to the attack check on its first Single Shot in combat (Zenith).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog > Variants).
